target.title: fix: stop model catalog sidecar read/write races
target.body:
Closes #99390

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where gateway/model catalog readers could observe plugin catalog sidecar directories while the model catalog writer was updating them, causing `FsSafeError: directory changed during operation` warnings and retry loops during provider model discovery.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing `models.json` write serialization now also protects reads that depend on the same `models.json` plus generated plugin catalog sidecar snapshot. The fix keeps the coordination inside the agent model catalog owner boundary and does not add config, migrations, or provider-specific policy.

## User Impact

Operators should no longer see the model catalog reader race the generated sidecar writer and loop on directory-change warnings while provider catalog sidecars are being refreshed. Read-only model catalog browsing waits for the in-process write to finish, then reads a stable persisted catalog snapshot.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: read-only persisted model catalog loading waits for an in-process `models.json` / plugin catalog sidecar write before reading sidecar rows.
- Commands / artifacts:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/model-catalog.test.ts src/agents/models-config.write-serialization.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-model-catalog.test.ts`
  - `git diff --check`
  - `.\node_modules\.bin\oxfmt.CMD --check --threads=1 src\agents\models-config-state.ts src\agents\models-config.ts src\agents\model-catalog.ts src\agents\model-catalog.test.ts`
- Observed result:
  - Agent tests passed: 2 files, 66 tests.
  - Gateway model catalog tests passed: 2 files, 12 tests.
  - `git diff --check` passed.
  - Touched-file `oxfmt --check` passed.
- Not tested / proof gaps:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-methods/models.test.ts` was attempted locally on Windows. With the correct gateway config, the behavior assertions ran, but the file failed during temp SQLite cleanup with `EBUSY: resource busy or locked, unlink ...openclaw.sqlite[-wal|-shm]` in pre-existing `withOpenClawTestState` auth-profile cases.
  - Crabbox/Testbox remote Linux proof was attempted but did not dispatch because the local `crabbox` entrypoint failed the repo wrapper sanity check: `selected binary failed basic --version/--help sanity checks`.
  - Autoreview was attempted twice. The first run hit Windows GBK decoding; reruns with `PYTHONUTF8=1` and `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` reached the Codex reviewer but failed before findings with `account_share_mode_unbound` from the configured reviewer provider.
